correctness.rationale: Exact finite-size martingale differences and variance recurrence are independently reconstructed from conditional insertion depths and match arXiv:2610.00614v1 equations (25)–(29). Their recurrence yields \(v_n\sim cn^{1-\beta}/(1-\beta)\) for \(\beta>1/2\), because the entire damping correction is \(o(n^{1-\beta})\). Riemann sums yield the explicit \(\beta<2/3\) constant; harmonic summation yields \(3c^3\) at \(\beta=2/3\). For \(\beta>2/3\), both the martingale and Kronecker remainder are square summable, yielding almost-sure and \(L^2\) convergence. Reproducible exact enumeration of sizes 3 through 7 with rational parent probabilities independently confirms the finite-size variance formulas. Numerical checks are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The motivating paper explicitly asks for deterministic-weight regimes beyond \(p_n=O(1/n)\) that retain a nondegenerate linear-scale limit. The model \(p_n=cn^{-\beta}\) is a natural one-parameter family with stretched-exponential cumulative weights, beyond existing polynomial regimes. The sharp \(2/3\) critical exponent, exact logarithmic critical coefficient, lower-side leading variance constant, and almost-sure/\(L^2\) limit on the other side give a complete, motivated fluctuation-phase classification for \(\beta\in(1/2,1)\).
